messages:
lena: CI preview failed on my PR (3498). Linkcheck + vale warnings, and a code sample is rendering weirdly in the preview. Need quick review/help.
sam: on it — can you paste the exact errors or the snippet? linkcheck usually outputs the broken URL.
lena: here's the snippet that broke rendering:
```markdown
See the migration from v1 to v2 by following this very long sentence that explains the process in passive voice and goes on and on without breaking which triggers vale.
```
Also linkcheck shows: "https://internal.example.com/setup" -> 404 (this is an internal service link we used).
docs-ci-bot: docs-preview failed for PR #3498 — linkcheck: 1 error (external/internal URL). vale: 2 warnings (passive voice, long sentence). Spellcheck: 0. Full log: https://ci.redwood/345/preview
kevin: passive voice + line-length. Vale wants shorter, active phrasing. Suggest: "Run the migration from v1 to v2 with the redwood migrate CLI." Keep lines <=120 chars.
sam: i'll make a tiny follow-up commit: replace internal link with public mirror, annotate the code fence language, and rephrase the sentence.
lena: great. also adding a language tag to the fence fixed a weird highlight bug in my local preview (```shell).
sam: pushed fix to branch -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3501/files — changed text, added:
```shell
redwood migrate --from v1 --to v2
```
and swapped the internal URL for https://docs.redwood.ai/setup-mirror
docs-ci-bot: Re-run triggered for PR #3498. Results: linkcheck: PASS. vale: WARN (1 warning: term "re-try" flagged; suggestion: use "retry"). Preview deploy: ✅
kevin: LGTM. approving now. Please merge before tomorrow's sprint freeze (5pm UTC) if possible. :rocket:
lena: awesome — thanks @sam and @kevin. merging now. :tada:
